about: Reference judgements of the equations of the 44 papers (ingest/final/<paper_id>/structure.json equations; Docling CodeFormula vs Marker). 13 papers on 2026-10-12: 103 pairs, the 74 agree pairs accepted by the pipeline and not judged, the 29 differ pairs judged on the formula crop. The other 31 papers on 2026-10-13: every pair marked differ (80) and every single-tool item (15) judged on the formula crop; agree pairs not judged. Verdicts: Marker right / Docling right / both wrong / not an error (equivalent forms); for a single-tool item the one tool right or wrong. Used to score the flag review step before it is used. The 14 in-scope papers ingested on 2026-10-13: every pair marked differ (49) and every single-tool item (7) judged on the formula crop; agree pairs not judged.
